name: TRIDENT
summary: A proposed multi-cubic-kilometre neutrino observatory in the South China Sea would provide near-equatorial sky coverage with hybrid optical sensors.
detection_principle: A large three-dimensional array of hybrid digital optical modules would combine photomultiplier and silicon-photomultiplier timing to reconstruct Cherenkov light in deep seawater.

sites.name: China; candidate deep-water site in the South China Sea

status.label: Research and development

results.summary: In-situ optical and environmental measurements supported a candidate telescope site; the pathfinder is not the full TRIDENT neutrino array.
